title: AI Foundations & Everyday Productivity
tagline: From curiosity to confidence: learn to use AI tools safely and productively in 4 weeks, no experience needed.
blurb: AI basics, tools, and everyday productivity.
audience: Students, job seekers, professionals, business owners, entrepreneurs, parents and seniors. Learners need only a smartphone or laptop, an email address and basic ability to type and browse. Day 1 includes a setup clinic for anyone who needs help creating accounts. Reading level: simple English with Swahili support; trainers should switch freely.
outcomes: Explain in plain language what AI is, what it can and cannot do, and why it sometimes gets things wrong
Write clear prompts using the R-T-C-F framework (Role, Task, Context, Format) and improve weak answers by iterating
Use AI for writing, research, translation (English/Swahili), planning, studying and spreadsheets
Create posters, social posts, CVs and simple business materials with AI and Canva
Spot scams, deepfakes and misinformation, and protect personal and customer data
Build a personal custom AI assistant and present a finished mini project
tools: Main AI assistants for chat, writing and research (use the free tier of at least two to compare)
Posters, social media graphics, CVs, presentations
Summarizing and questioning documents and notes
Catalog, quick replies and AI-written messages for small business
glance: 4 weeks, 5 days a week, 3 hours per day (60 contact hours) plus unlimited workspace time for practice
Beginner. No coding, no prior AI experience
About 25% demo, 65% hands-on labs, 10% discussion and sharing
A personal AI toolkit, 8 finished portfolio pieces, a custom AI assistant and a demo day presentation

title: AI Projects, Content & Automation
tagline: Turn AI skills into real projects, automated workflows and income: for creators, professionals and business owners.
blurb: Practical projects, content creation, automation and business use.
audience: Beginner path graduates, or anyone who already uses AI tools weekly and can write structured prompts. Basic spreadsheet skills required. Learners without the Beginner path take a 90-minute placement test on Day 1 (prompting, safe use, Google Sheets basics). No coding required; logical thinking is enough.
outcomes: Use advanced prompting: prompt chains, few-shot examples, personas, structured output and self-critique
Run a repeatable content engine for a brand: research, calendar, copy, graphics, short video scripts
Build no-code automations connecting Google Sheets, Forms, Gmail and messaging with AI steps
Analyze business data with AI and present insights as dashboards and short reports
Create AI customer support and sales assistants that use a business's own information
Package, price and pitch AI services for local clients and online freelancing platforms
tools: Advanced prompting, projects, custom assistants, data analysis
Make.com or n8n (cloud free tier) / Zapier
Short video editing with AI captions
glance: 4 weeks, 5 days a week, 3 hours per day (60 contact hours) plus unlimited workspace time
Intermediate. Comfortable with ChatGPT-style tools and basic prompting
20% demo, 70% build time, 10% critique and sharing. Every day ends with something that works.
3 working automations, a content engine, a client-ready AI service offer and a capstone for a real or simulated client

title: Building Custom AI Solutions
tagline: Code, APIs, RAG, agents and deployment: build and ship real AI applications for Kenyan and global users.
blurb: Custom AI solutions, automation, APIs, and real-world applications.
audience: Intermediate path graduates with coding exposure, developers, IT students and technical professionals. Prerequisites: variables, functions, lists/dictionaries, loops and reading error messages in Python or similar. A Day 1 diagnostic coding quiz places learners; a 6-hour optional 'Python Bootcamp' is offered the weekend before. Learners need a laptop (4 GB RAM minimum) and Google account for Colab.
outcomes: Call large language model APIs from Python, control output and handle errors, cost and rate limits
Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) apps that answer from private documents with citations
Design agents that use tools and external APIs (payments sandbox, messaging, databases) safely
Evaluate AI systems with test sets, metrics and guardrails; reduce hallucination and abuse risk
Create user interfaces with Streamlit or Gradio and back-ends with FastAPI
Deploy, monitor and secure an application and explain trade-offs to a client or employer
tools: Core development environment and version control
LLM provider APIs (free credits or low-cost keys)
Text generation, embeddings, tool use; budget approx. USD 5 per learner for the month
Open models, datasets, embeddings and Spaces hosting
Safaricom Daraja sandbox, WhatsApp Cloud API sandbox
glance: 4 weeks, 5 days a week, 3 hours per day (60 contact hours) plus unlimited workspace time
Advanced. Basic programming experience required (Python preferred)
15% concepts, 75% coding labs and pair programming, 10% code review and demos
A deployed AI application with API backend, document question-answering (RAG), an agent with tools, tests and a demo
